regions.today: Blustery today with sunny spells and scattered showers. Parts of the southeast will stay fully dry though. The showers will clear this evening and brisk northwesterly winds will ease with late sunshine occurring widely. A fresh day with highest temperatures of 15 to 17 degrees.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry with clear spells. Cool with lowest temperatures of 6 to 10 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly dry with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. Cloud increasing in the evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees with light to moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Tuesday and moderate on Wednesday.
